name: com.xpturn.assetlink
description: A lightweight wrapper library for Unity Addressables system. It provides simple and safe handling of asset loading, prefab instantiation, and scene management. This is an Addressable asset reference type that can be used instead of AssetReference provided by Unity Addressables.

samples.description: Contains sample code and assets for the AssetLink library.
Contains test code for the AssetLink library. Samples folder is needed for the tests to work.
